features:
Silent Aim
-Visibility Check
-Hookshot Mode
-Target Mode (Hull/Ammo)
-Aim Method (Closest/Cursor)
-Show FOV Circle
-FOV Size
-FOV Circle Color
-FOV Circle Thickness
-Tracer
-Tracer Color
-Tracer Thickness


Tank Mods
-Infinite MG Ammo
-Infinite Tank Ammo
-Swap to Driver (Keep Turret)
-Shell Mods (dynamic value editor)
Solo Mode
Mouse Aim


Gun Modifiers
-Ammo Modifier (ammo type select)
-Bullet Modifier (dynamic value editor, auto/manual mode)


Movement
-Flight (speed, keybind)
-WalkSpeed (speed, keybind)
-Freecam (speed, keybind)


Player Visuals
-Player ESP (boxes, names, distance, health bar, team indicator, max distance, team/self check)
-Player Chams (fill/outline color & transparency, depth mode, team color, max distance)


Vehicle Visuals
-Vehicle ESP (boxes, names, distance, team indicator, fonts, max distance)
-Vehicle Chams (fill/outline color & transparency, depth mode, team color, max distance)


Vehicle Spy
-Health Spy (FOV, display mode, tracer)
-Ammo Chams (fill/outline color & transparency, depth mode, team color, max distance)


Local Visuals
-Custom Atmosphere (density, offset, haze, glare, color, decay)
-Custom Lighting (brightness, clock time, exposure, shadows, ambient colors, fog)


Misc
-Instant Place
-Refill Ammo
-No Camera Shake
